name: Baked Garlic-Herb Chicken Wings with Greek Salad with Feta

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 245°C (475°F). Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and divide between the baking sheets. Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with garlic, and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp basil, dried
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 tomatoes
3 orange bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers; medium dice tomatoes. Add both to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Add olives and feta to the bowl; stir to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
